title: Trend
description: A cluster of signals that share an underlying movement, written by the Trend Analyst, with the intuition prompt written by the Interrogator. Everything in a Trend is shown before the viewer's gut reading is recorded, so everything in it must be lens-neutral. A Trend holds its three Readings by reference, one per lens: the Reading content ships in a separate module (data/reveal/<trendId>.js) that is imported only after the intuition record exists. Shipped in data/trends.js as an array.

summary.description: What is moving and over what period, in prose, with no opportunity, threat or noise direction and no statement of strength or urgency.

intuitionPrompt.description: The single Interrogation question shown before the readings. Held on the Trend, not on the Interrogation, so that the whole Interrogation can be loaded after the intuition record (A-4).

signalIds.description: The signals this trend rests on. Array order carries no meaning; the UI orders signals by publication date (C-4). A trend resting on one signal says so by having one entry.

readings.description: Exactly three references, one per lens. They are unordered peers: array order carries no meaning and the UI ignores it, showing them in an order drawn at random per trend per page load (Q-2). Only the lens and the reading identifier appear here, never reading content.

label.description: Written offline by the Trend Analyst and the Interrogator: ai-generated (DM-2).
